_comment: Computer Science and ICT Teaching Methods -- Secondary School Teachers' Diploma syllabus, Years 1-2.
THEME. The file name carries none of SYLLABUS / TED / VALIDATED; the engine now also takes
"TEACHING METHODS" as a syllabus name (themes.js autoTheme), so it is on the generic syllabus theme.
TITLE / LEVEL / YEAR. "Computer Science and ICT Teaching Methods" as the manuscript's title page has it
(the cover writes "&", the file name "-"); Secondary School Teachers' Diploma as cover and title page say;
2025 as on the copyright line (the manuscript's cover says 2026), as in Computer Science and ICT.
YEAR PAGES. The manuscript heads each matrix "Year 1 – Course Content" / "Year 2 – Course Content";
cut to "Year 1" / "Year 2" so each sets as its own level page before its matrix.
MATRIX NUMBERS. Topic 1.1-1.12 (Year 1) and 2.1-2.4 (Year 2), numbering check clean as typed.
The back matter keeps the author's own section numbers 1.7-1.12 (Method of Teaching ... Recommended
Books), which follow on from the front matter's 1.1-1.6, not from the matrix.

PROOFREAD round 1 (Google Drive comments, 2026-10-22..23): 15 comments (M. C. Mabbola, Misheck Mutuzana). 'P.O. BOX' -> 'P.O. Box' is in the template (imprint, every syllabus); '1.6.4 General Competences and Descriptors' indented, plain in the contents is an engine rule (a numbered front-matter competences heading stays nested). The rest below.
